name: Local VM
note: Agent code runs in a VM on your computer
summary: The agent's shell commands and generated code run inside a lightweight Linux virtual machine on the user's own computer, started with the operating system's hypervisor. Only folders the user picks are mounted, so the agent can work on local files without reaching the rest of the machine.
how: The app starts a Linux VM with the platform hypervisor
Folders the user selects are mounted into the VM
Shell commands and code run inside the VM, with network egress filtered
The agent loop can stay on the host and send only execution into the VM
facts: Apple Virtualization framework on macOS, Hyper-V on Windows (Cowork)
Stronger isolation than a per-command sandbox, but needs hardware virtualization
goodFor: Running agent-written code for users who don't read bash
Working on local files without exposing the whole disk
watchOut: Devices without virtualization support can't run commands
Endpoint security (EDR) tools can't see inside the VM
